description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.
